sourceFiles.notes: Authored key poses from image generation; explicit empty-gutter row crops preserve complete shoes where the nominal 512px cell boundary crosses them. Integer translation only aligns support soles to y470 or declared airborne height. Common 2:1 nearest sampling; no per-pose fitting, retouching, interpolation or regenerated anatomy. Idle source drawings are nearly static; no invented blink. Revision2 adds the recorded whole-pose horizontal offsets to reduce atlas drift. Vertical registration, scale and timing are retained. This does not correct within-drawing head shape or head-to-sole proportion.

Revision2 selected whole-pose image-generation continuity repair. The full unchanged generated PNG and exact prompt/reference record are retained under stability-v2. Faces, ears and necks are authored coherently with the body; no pasted head or runtime deformation. Reviewed 530px row gutter preserves complete shoes. Whole-pose integer registration targets planted or airborne soles, with common 2:1 nearest sampling and existing 32px top padding. All action frame IDs, order, FPS, loop, anchor and native dimensions are retained. Selected stable-v1 reduces head perspective changes and opposite-stride crown-height mismatch. Native crown tops remain[31,28,26,22,30,28,28,24], so the action still has an8px peak adjacent jump; this is an improvement, not a claim of perfect smoothness. Support/flight target pattern is retained.
